messages.subject: For Ulrika Areskog Lilja | Mining technology, brand and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Epiroc Media Relations Team,

Please route this executive introduction to Ms. Ulrika Areskog Lilja, incoming Senior Vice President Brand & Communications, or to the appropriate current executive sponsor ahead of her November appointment.

Epiroc's growth sits at the center of mining's shift toward automation, digitalization, electrification and safer operations. The strongest corporate narrative around those technologies is built when communications reflect how customers, regulators, communities and operating teams experience them in practice.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory inside a major mining operation. I also support stakeholder governance around industrial renewable-energy infrastructure and carbon-data evidence work.

I would value a conversation about where this operator-side perspective might support Epiroc's brand, communications, stakeholder, sustainability or regional market priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Epiroc.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
